suite_name: PCIS VIP Pipeline & Defect Verification Suite

pipeline_tests_executed.name: Normal pipeline
pipeline_tests_executed.expected_result: Transaction moves through every stage successfully
pipeline_tests_executed.actual_result: All 18 monthly cycles processed without error

pipeline_tests_executed.name: Missing document
pipeline_tests_executed.expected_result: Pipeline flags missing document and prevents invalid progression

pipeline_tests_executed.name: Duplicate event
pipeline_tests_executed.expected_result: Reprocessing event does not create duplicate payments or records
pipeline_tests_executed.actual_result: Duplicate blocked, balance intact, 1 item stored

pipeline_tests_executed.name: Failed stage & Retry
pipeline_tests_executed.expected_result: Error is logged and the transaction can be safely retried
pipeline_tests_executed.actual_result: FAILED_STAGE_ERROR logged to audit trail, safe retry succeeded

pipeline_tests_executed.name: Status mismatch
pipeline_tests_executed.expected_result: A shipment cannot be marked delivered without required confirmation

pipeline_tests_executed.name: Data consistency
pipeline_tests_executed.defect_tested: Mismatched references between PI, PO, LC, B/L
pipeline_tests_executed.expected_result: PI, PO, LC, B/L, customs, and delivery records remain correctly linked
pipeline_tests_executed.actual_result: All identifiers verified consistent across cycles

pipeline_tests_executed.name: Financial reconciliation
pipeline_tests_executed.expected_result: Customer invoices, receipts, and outstanding balances match ledger
pipeline_tests_executed.actual_result: Formula matches 18/18 monthly steps and final $3,000 balance

pipeline_tests_executed.name: Pipeline recovery
pipeline_tests_executed.expected_result: Interrupted processing resumes without losing or duplicating transactions
pipeline_tests_executed.actual_result: Resumed from M10 to M18 without data loss or duplication

pipeline_tests_executed.name: Unauthorized transition
pipeline_tests_executed.defect_tested: Bypassing intermediate stages or unauthorized role transition
pipeline_tests_executed.expected_result: Users cannot bypass restricted stages or act without authority
pipeline_tests_executed.actual_result: Stage skipping and guest roles blocked with security exceptions

pipeline_tests_executed.name: Audit trail
pipeline_tests_executed.expected_result: Each status change records relevant user, time, and action
pipeline_tests_executed.actual_result: Immutable audit entries generated for every event

pipeline_tests_executed.name: Negative amount defect
pipeline_tests_executed.expected_result: Negative procurement values or payments must be rejected

pipeline_tests_executed.name: Invalid LC status defect
pipeline_tests_executed.expected_result: Pipeline must reject non-banking LC statuses
